meta.title: Jarvis HUD
meta.description: Glacier-slate HUD skin with ice-blue accents for the DSH web client. It recolors surfaces, borders, focus and selection, uses frosted-glass menus (translucent panels with a blur), and keeps a warm reactor core only in the brand mark and the boot sequence. Use Settings → General → Jarvis HUD to switch the skin, set the boot policy, choose the tempo or replay the sequence; the skin is presentation only and sends nothing to external services. Light mode is a frosted paper-white variant.
